summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 'Full Trip Plan' feature (GlobeTrotter). Verified navigation from /trips/:id/view via full-trip-plan-btn to /trips/:id/plan, rendering of legend, single combined Leaflet map, ordered 'Complete roadmap' list, Google Maps deep link, back navigation, mobile layout and invalid-trip error state. Auth via add_init_script setting gt_token=test_session_roadtrip_123. Since no seeded trip had itinerary sections with coordinates, I temporarily created 2 TEST_ sections (Pune, Kolhapur) with coords via API to validate itinerary-place rendering, then deleted them (verified 0 sections remaining).

minor.issue: Google Maps link includes only overnight-stay waypoints (waypoints=17.18,73.54) and omits itinerary places with coordinates, so the external link is not the 'full' plan shown on the in-app map. Consider including itinerary stops as waypoints (Google Maps supports up to 9).

issues: Roadmap ordering is fixed as Start -> all overnight stays -> all itinerary places -> Destination, which can be geographically out of order (e.g. Pune itinerary stop listed after an overnight stay that is farther along the route). Consider interleaving by route progress / waypoint distance so the roadmap reads in true travel order.

action_items: OPTIONAL: interleave overnight stays and itinerary places by route order (waypoint distance / order_index) instead of grouping by type, so 'Complete roadmap' reflects real travel sequence.
OPTIONAL: include itinerary place coordinates as waypoints in /trips/:id/final-map-link so 'Open in Google Maps' matches the full in-app map.
critical_code_review_comments: FullTripPlan.jsx: the three initial API calls silently swallow errors for overnight-stays and route-plan (empty catch). A failed route-plan degrades to a straight dashed line with no user feedback — consider a small non-blocking toast/inline notice.

FullTripPlan.jsx has no loading state distinction between 'loading' and 'trip has no coordinates'; a trip without start/dest coords renders an empty map centered on India with no explanatory empty state.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created and then deleted 2 sections (TEST_Pune Stopover, TEST_Kolhapur Palace) on trip a081374d-3e37-4cbb-a24e-48e10a7de27a. No residual test data.
test_credentials: localStorage gt_token = test_session_roadtrip_123 (must be set before app load via add_init_script)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified results: full-trip-plan-btn on ItineraryView navigates to /plan; page renders full-trip-plan-page, fulltrip-legend (4 colors), fulltrip-map-panel > trip-map with 15 tiles, 1 route polyline (real OSRM geometry) and markers labeled A, H1, 1, 2, B in order; subtitle correctly reports 'Mumbai -> Goa · 5 points on the map'; roadmap list order Start -> Test Hotel (overnight stay near Sangameshwar) -> itinerary places -> Goa destination; marker popups show title + place name; fulltrip-google-maps-btn opens a new tab with a valid google.com/maps/dir URL; fulltrip-back-btn returns to /trips/:id/view. Invalid trip id renders 'Could not load this trip.' Mobile (390x844) layout is clean. No console/page errors, no error elements. Seeded trips have 0 itinerary sections by default — create sections with lat/lon via POST /api/trips/{id}/sections to test itinerary-stop rendering.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found in the new feature. The two minor observations are design/backend-scope choices, not failures.
